# Feed fixtures (captured 2026-11-09)

Real public responses, captured with `curl -A "lattice-wildfire/0.1 (tanner@meshvault.ai)"`. All keyless. All HTTP 200. No file exceeds 5 MB, so nothing was trimmed except where noted (FIRMS CA bbox filter, perimeter simplification `maxAllowableOffset=0.0005`, national perimeter sample of 10).

Notes:
- FIRMS Suomi NPP file is header-only: 0 rows at capture.
- WFIGS CA incidents: `POOState` values are `US-XX` (e.g. `US-CA`). Perimeter layer field is `attr_POOState`.
- CAL FIRE: 567 records, none active; use as schema fixture, not as a live-fire fixture.
- NWS Red Flag Warning feed is empty today. Use the CA alerts file for non-empty alert parsing.
- `nws-points-*` `forecast`/`forecastHourly` URLs: see Source URL column of the forecast rows.
